name: trove
description: Search, save and organize everything you've saved to Trove.

interface.longDescription:
Trove is where people keep the things they find online: restaurants and places, recipes, products, articles, videos and social posts, saved from any app with one tap. Trove fills in the title, image, category and tags for every save and lets you organize them into collections.

With Trove in ChatGPT you can:
- Find what you saved: "what was that ramen place in Tokyo I saved?"
- Get the details: opening hours and address for a place, ingredients and steps for a recipe, the details you saved for a product.
- Save as you go: save a link with a note and tags, straight into a collection.
- Organize: create collections, add or remove saves, and tidy titles, notes and tags.

ChatGPT only sees your own Trove, with the same access you have in the app. You approve the connection on Trove and can disconnect any time in Trove under Settings, Connected AIs. Requires a Trove account.
defaultPrompt: What restaurants have I saved in Trove?
Find the recipes I saved and pick one for dinner tonight.
Save this link to my Trove.

positive.prompt: What have I saved in Trove recently?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the user's most recent saves with titles, categories and links.

positive.prompt: Show me the full details of the first one.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows that save's note, description, tags and product or place details, and which collections it is in.

positive.prompt: What collections and tags do I have in Trove?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the user's collection(s) and its most used tags with counts.

positive.description: Save a link with a note
positive.prompt: Save https://www.seriouseats.com/the-food-lab-best-chocolate-chip-cookie-recipe to my Trove with the note 'try for the bake sale'.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the save (or returns the existing one) and confirms it with its title and the note.

positive.prompt: Make a collection called Baking and put that cookie recipe in it, and tag it dessert.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a private 'Baking' collection containing the save and adds the 'dessert' tag.

negative.description: General question unrelated to the user's saves
negative.prompt: What is the capital of Australia?
Show me the private saves of the Trove user @parker.

negative.description: Action Trove has no tool for
negative.prompt: Post my latest Trove save to Instagram.

review.commerce_description: Trove does not sell products or process payments. It only reads and organizes links the user has saved.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: search, read, save, edit and organize your Trove saves from ChatGPT.
